exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "~ba ii (should / it would be good if)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～ばいい matches "~ba ii (should / it would be good if)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～ばいい.
exercises.explanation: Expresses advice or suggestion; means "should" or "it would be good if."
